scope.candidate_endpoint: Heat-attributable learning or attendance losses during school days
excluded: lifetime earnings derived from test-score changes
educational inequality without a separable welfare measure

forbidden_claims: test-score loss equals lifetime earnings loss
school air-conditioning cost equals welfare damage
scenario-average learning damages are a marginal pulse SCC
unlock_requirements: Reconstruct a published causal school-day temperature response from an auditable artifact
Run identical school-calendar daily temperature bins for matched GIVE baseline and one-ton pulse climates
Validate transfer across climates educational systems income groups and baseline cooling access
Specify fixed trend and upper adaptation scenarios with school cooling capital and electricity separated from GIVE energy damages
Use a published direct resource-cost or willingness-to-pay measure rather than an assumed test-score-to-earnings conversion
Demonstrate non-overlap with labor productivity agriculture health energy and top-down macro damages
Propagate response climate-pattern population enrollment valuation and adaptation uncertainty
